Objective: Confirm the test connection reaches an Oracle Database and record product, version and schema in the report.
Preconditions: Oracle running and reachable; ORACLE_* variables set; table PERSON exists (npm run db:init).
Steps: 1) Connect with ORACLE_USER/ORACLE_PASSWORD. 2) Run SQL ENV-01. 3) Run SQL ENV-02. 4) Attach the result to the report.
Expected Result: ENV-01 returns a product starting with 'Oracle'; ENV-02 returns session user, container and service.
Notes / Defect Ref: Setup gate for all DB and API tests. Evidence that Oracle (not H2) was used. Authoring environment had no Oracle, Docker or Maven Central access.

Objective: Confirm table PERSON exists in the connected schema.

Steps: 1) Run SQL DQ-01.
Expected Result: Exactly one row (PERSON).
Notes / Defect Ref: A missing table is a setup problem (run npm run db:init), not an application defect.

Objective: NOT NULL is enforced by the database on FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME and BIRTH_DATE.
